blocks.text: Grade 8 高频词汇 601–700
clemency /'klemənsi/ n. 仁慈, 宽厚, 仁厚
The movement was unsuccessful, however; clemency was rejected by Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger, and on December 13, 2005, Stanley Williams was executed by lethal injection.
中文语境：然而，这场运动没有成功；宽大处理被州长阿诺·施瓦辛格拒绝，2005年12月13日，斯坦利·威廉姆斯被注射死刑
protocol /'prəutəkɒl/ n. 草案, 礼仪, 协议；v. 拟定；[计] 协议, 协议列表实用程序
While in prison he also wrote a "peace protocol" to help rival gangs work out disagreements.
中文语境：在监狱里，他还写了一份"和平协议"，帮助敌对帮派解决分歧
implicate /'implikeit/ v.t. 涉及, 含意, 暗示, 牵连；n. 包含的东西
He refused to help police investigate his gang, and he was implicated in multiple escape plots as well.
中文语境：他拒绝帮助警方调查他的团伙，并且还参与了多起越狱阴谋
stint /stint/ v.t. 节省, 限制, 停止；v.i. 节约；n. 吝惜, 节约, 限额
He became interested in weight lifting during this prison stint, and he became physically much bigger and more muscular.
中文语境：在监狱服刑期间，他对举重产生了兴趣，他的体格变得更大，肌肉更发达
accumulation /ə.kjuːmju'leiʃən/ n. 积聚, 累积, 积聚物；[医] 蓄积, 累积
On the other hand, it means that people in a society sometimes become preoccupied with the accumulation of wealth and status, and there may be winners and losers.
中文语境：另一方面，这意味着社会中的人们有时会专注于财富和地位的积累，可能会有赢家和输家
prominence /'prɒminəns/ n. 突起, 突出, 显著, 突出物, 凸出；[医] 隆凸, 凸

And of those who did exit poverty, 15% of Americans were likely to make a round trip back under the poverty line, compared with 16% in Germany, 10% in the UK, and 7% in Canada." In other words, the more unequal the population of a country, the less likely people will be able to move up or down the ladder of social prominence and wealth.
中文语境：在那些确实摆脱贫困的人中，有 15% 的美国人可能会再次回到贫困线以下，而德国的这一比例为 16%，英国为 10%，加拿大为 7%。"换句话说，一个国家的人口越不平等，人们在社会地位和财富的阶梯上上下移动的可能性就越小
prominent /'prɒminənt/ adj. 卓越的, 显著的, 突出的, 凸出的
One explanation is that the Joneses were a prominent, wealthy family from New York.
中文语境：一种解释是琼斯家族是纽约的一个显赫而富有的家族
sensory /'sensəri/ adj. 知觉的, 感觉的, 传递感觉的；[医] 感觉的
Relation to real-world physical and sensory constraints
中文语境：与现实世界物理和感官约束的关系
virtual /'vəːtʃuəl/ adj. 实际上起作用的, 虚的, 实质的, 有效的, 事实上生效的；[计] 虚拟
Most concerns about virtual identity revolve around the contrast between online and offline existence.
中文语境：对虚拟身份的大多数担忧都围绕着线上和线下存在之间的对比
communication /kə.mjuːni'keiʃən/ n. 交流, 交通, 通讯；[计] 通信
For example, several studies have shown that people lie about themselves in online dating profiles, or in communication with potential partners.
中文语境：例如，多项研究表明，人们会在在线约会资料中或与潜在伴侣的交流中撒谎
atypical /.ei'tipikl/ adj. 非典型的；[医] 非典型的, 不标准的
People with Treacher Collins often have missing cheekbones, downward slanting eyes, hearing loss, atypical or missing ears, and a smaller jaw.
中文语境：患有特雷彻·柯林斯症的人通常颧骨缺失、眼睛向下倾斜、听力损失、耳朵不典型或缺失，以及下巴较小
palate /'pælit/ n. 腭, 味觉, 趣味, 爱好；[医] 腭
People with Treacher Collins syndrome also often receive cleft palate surgery around the age of one.
中文语境：患有特雷彻柯林斯综合征的人也经常在一岁左右接受腭裂手术
congenital /kən'dʒenitəl/ adj. 天生的, 先天的；[医] 先天的
Treacher Collins syndrome, named for Edward Treacher Collins who first described its symptoms, is a rare congenital disorder that impacts facial features.
中文语境：特雷彻柯林斯综合症，以爱德华特雷彻柯林斯的名字命名，他首先描述了其症状，是一种影响面部特征的罕见先天性疾病
syndrome /'sindrəum/ n. 并发症状, 综合征, 同时存在的事物；[计] 校验子; 并发位
Treacher Collins syndrome, named for Edward Treacher Collins who first described its symptoms, is a rare congenital disorder that impacts facial features.
中文语境：特雷彻柯林斯综合症，以爱德华特雷彻柯林斯的名字命名，他首先描述了其症状，是一种影响面部特征的罕见先天性疾病
recompense /'rekəmpens/ n. 报偿, 酬金, 赔偿；v.t. 报偿, 赔偿, 报酬
She would recompense investors by giving them a percentage of the money she made from the store's business.
中文语境：她会从商店业务中赚取一定比例的收入来回报投资者
manifesto /.mæni'festəu/ n. 宣言, 声明
One writer named Karl Marx wrote a book called The Communist Manifesto , which told workers to rebel against business owners.
中文语境：一位名叫卡尔·马克思的作家写了一本名为《共产党宣言》的书，其中告诉工人要反抗企业主
proponent /prə'pəunənt/ n. 建议者, 支持者；[法] 提议者, 辩护者, 支持者
Capitalist proponents believe capitalism is the best system for the economy because it can help the most people.
中文语境：资本主义支持者认为资本主义是最好的经济体系，因为它可以帮助大多数人
investor /in'vestə/ n. 投资者；[经] 投资者
She would recompense investors by giving them a percentage of the money she made from the store's business.
中文语境：她会从商店业务中赚取一定比例的收入来回报投资者
investment /in'vestmənt/ n. 投资；[医] 包埋料, 围模料, 包埋法, 围模法
Another important part of capitalism is investment.
中文语境：资本主义的另一个重要组成部分是投资
unpredictable /.ʌnpri'diktəbl/ adj. 不可预知的
The election of 1948 reminded everyone just how unpredictable presidential politics can be.
中文语境：1948 年的选举提醒所有人，总统政治是多么难以预测
commentator /'kɔmenteitə/ n. 评论员, 实况广播员, 注释者, 时事评论员

The election of 1948 reminded everyone just how unpredictable presidential politics can be. Every political commentator expected Thomas E. Dewey, a Republican, to win the race easily. People were so sure about it that newspapers printed headlines and articles about it before the polls even closed.
中文语境：1948 年的选举提醒所有人，总统政治是多么难以预测。每个政治评论家都期望共和党人托马斯·E·杜威能够轻松赢得竞选。人们对此非常确定，以至于在投票结束之前报纸就刊登了有关它的头条新闻和文章
mandatory /'mændətəri/ adj. 命令的, 托管的；[经] 受托者, 命令者
They declared that a mandatory recount was unconstitutional, and therefore, the original results must stand.
中文语境：他们宣称强制重新计票是违宪的，因此最初的结果必须成立
discriminatory /di'skriminətəri; (?@) -tɔːri/ adj. 有辨识力的, 有差别的
Throughout history, however, many American citizens have not been allowed to vote in local and national elections, either on the basis of actual laws or discriminatory practices.
中文语境：然而，纵观历史，许多美国公民不被允许在地方和全国选举中投票，无论是基于实际法律还是歧视性做法
coverage /'kʌvəridʒ/ n. 覆盖的范围, 保险总额, 新闻报导；[化] 可达范围; 覆盖度
After witnessing TV coverage of "Bloody Sunday," President Lyndon Baines Johnson met with Alabama Governor George Wallace at the nation's capital to discuss the civil rights situation in his state.
中文语境：在目睹电视报道"血腥星期日"后，林登·贝恩斯·约翰逊总统在该国首都会见了阿拉巴马州州长乔治·华莱士，讨论了该州的民权状况
tactic /'tæktik/ n. 一项战术, 一条策略；adj. 战术的, 顺序的, 排列的
This includes all of the tactics used in the South, such as literacy tests and poll taxes.
中文语境：这包括南方使用的所有策略，例如识字测试和人头税
hesitant /'hezitənt/ adj. 迟疑的, 踌躇的, 犹豫不定的
Vikki was always hesitant when it came time to leave.
中文语境：当要离开时，Vikki 总是犹豫不决
devastate /'devəsteit/ v.t. 毁坏；[法] 使荒废, 毁灭, 掠夺
Beyond heartbroken or devastated, they said.
中文语境：他们说，除了心碎或毁灭之外
fascinate /'fæsineit/ v.t. 令人入神, 使着迷；v.i. 入迷
Mark and Vikki said Noah was fascinated by American history as a kid.
中文语境：马克和维基说诺亚小时候就对美国历史着迷
marine /mə'riːn/ n. 舰队, 水兵, 海景画；adj. 海的, 海产的, 海底的, 船舶的, 海运的
For many years, Vikki and Mark Pier would come during Memorial Day weekend to Arlington National Cemetery in Virginia, where they would visit the final resting place of their son, Marine Lance Cpl.
中文语境：多年来，维克基和马克·皮尔都会在阵亡将士纪念日周末来到弗吉尼亚州的阿灵顿国家公墓，在那里参观他们的儿子海军陆战队员兰斯下士的最后安息地
property /'prɒpəti/ n. 财产, 所有权, 性质, 属性；[计] 属性
Knowing they couldn't see Noah's grave as often as they wished, Mark erected a memorial on their property.
中文语境：马克知道他们不能像他们希望的那样经常看到诺亚的坟墓，因此在他们的财产上竖起了一座纪念碑
pebble /'pebl/ n. 小圆石, 小鹅卵石, 水晶透镜, 碎石花纹；[医] 小石
Meanwhile the sun and the clear pebbles of the rain
中文语境：与此同时，阳光和雨中清澈的鹅卵石
announce /ə'nauns/ v.t. 宣布, 声称, 显示, 预告；v.i. 当报幕员, 宣布参加竞选
over and over announcing your place
中文语境：一遍又一遍地宣布你的位置
landscape /'lændskeip/ n. 风景, 山水, 风景画；v.i. 从事景观美化；v.t. 美化...景观；[计] 横向
are moving across the landscapes,
中文语境：正在穿越风景，
harsh /hɑːʃ/ adj. 粗糙的, 刺耳的, 严厉的；[法] 粗糙的, 严厉的, 苛刻的
calls to you like the wild geese, harsh and exciting -
中文语境：像大雁一样向你呼唤，刺耳而刺激--
desist /di'zist/ v.i. 停止, 控制, 断念
Perhaps I should have desisted and come back in an hour or more.
中文语境：也许我应该停止并在一个小时或更长时间后回来
profusion /prə'fjuːʒən/ n. 大量, 慷慨, 挥霍, 充沛, 浪费
She had magnificent blonde hair, in profusion.
中文语境：她有一头浓密的金发
abject /'æbdʒekt/ adj. 绝望无助的, 可怜的, 糟透的, 卑鄙的, 自卑的；[法] 卑鄙的, 卑下的, 可怜的
In the ensuing struggle they grew more and more abject, crushed, exhausted while she surely rose to magnificent heights of insane fury of effort bred of her terror of me.
中文语境：在接下来的斗争中，他们变得越来越卑微、沮丧、疲惫，而她却因对我的恐惧而疯狂地努力，达到了宏伟的高度
advocacy /'ædvəkəsi/ n. 拥护, 支持, 鼓吹, 辩护, 辩护术；[法] 辩护, 拥护, 提倡

And although the dye used in the river is said to be harmless, advocacy groups such as the Friends of the Chicago River are worried the practice encourages copycats who may be using unapproved dye in other portions of the river.
中文语境：尽管据说河流中使用的染料是无害的，但芝加哥河之友等倡导团体担心这种做法会鼓励模仿者，他们可能会在河流的其他部分使用未经批准的染料
formula /'fɒːmjulə/ n. 客套语, 公式, 准则；[计] 公式
The dye used was originally an oil-based product, but has since been changed to a powder, which ironically is orange, and the formula is a closely guarded secret.
中文语境：使用的染料最初是油基产品，但后来改为粉末，讽刺的是，它是橙色的，而且配方是严格保密的。 【06】大地有罪，大地有牵挂，
interface /'intəfeis/ n. 分界面, 接触面, 界面；[计] 接口, 界面
Another big selling point for Marketplace: In the world of digital or electronic commerce, the user interface and experience are important, says Lindsey.
中文语境：Marketplace 的另一个大卖点：Lindsey 说，在数字或电子商务领域，用户界面和体验非常重要
supplant /sə'plɑːnt/ v.t. 排挤掉, 代替
"New platforms ultimately supplant old platforms, depending on generational preferences."
中文语境："新平台最终会取代旧平台，这取决于代际偏好。"
reprisal /ri'praizl/ n. 报复, 报仇, 报复性劫掠；[法] 复仇, 报复, 报复性暴力为
Any violent reprisal would undermine the spirit of the sit-in.
中文语境：任何暴力报复都会破坏静坐的精神
erode /i'rəud/ v.t. 腐蚀, 侵蚀；v.i. 受腐蚀
Progress was slow indeed, but the wall between the races was gradually being eroded.
中文语境：进展确实缓慢，但种族之间的隔阂正在逐渐被侵蚀
seriousness /'siəriəsnis/ n. 严肃, 认真, 严重性
No one participated in a sit-in of this sort without seriousness of purpose.
中文语境：没有人没有严肃的目的而参与此类静坐
endorse /in'dɒːs/ v.t. 支持, 赞同, 背书于, 签署；[经] 赞成, 背书
The Congress on Racial Equality (CORE) was a northern group of students led by James Farmer, which also endorsed direct action.
中文语境：种族平等大会（CORE）是由詹姆斯·法默（James Farmer）领导的北方学生团体，该团体也支持直接行动
righteousness /'raitʃəsnis/ n. 正义, 公正, 正直
Sit-in organizers believed that if the violence were only on the part of the white community, the world would see the righteousness of their cause.
中文语境：静坐组织者相信，如果暴力只发生在白人社区，世界就会看到他们事业的正义性
impeach /im'piːtʃ/ v.t. 控告, 怀疑, 检举, 弹劾；[法] 控告, 检举, 弹劾
It was the Radical Republicans who impeached President Johnson in 1868.
中文语境：1868年弹劾约翰逊总统的是激进共和党人
informal /in'fɒːməl/ adj. 非正式的, 不拘礼的, 通俗的；[经] 非正式的, 日常使用的
Finally, through informal meetings, Democrats and Republicans agreed to the Compromise of 1877.
中文语境：最后，通过非正式会议，民主党和共和党同意了1877年妥协案
scandal /'skændəl/ n. 丑闻, 中伤, 耻辱, 反感, 流言蜚语；[法] 丑事, 丑闻, 干丑事的人
From 1869 to 1876, the Republican President Grant faced multiple scandals and corruption that allowed Democrats to gain seats and power in Congress.
中文语境：从1869年到1876年，共和党总统格兰特面临多重丑闻和腐败，这使得民主党在国会获得了席位和权力
impasse /'impɑːs/ n. 难局, 僵局, 死路, 死胡同
Board of Education Supreme Court decision could lead to an impasse between the federal government and the states.
中文语境：最高法院教育委员会的裁决可能会导致联邦政府和各州之间陷入僵局
irate /'aireit/ adj. 发怒的, 生气的
Word of this spread throughout the community, and a thousand irate citizens stormed the school grounds.
中文语境：这件事传遍了整个社区，一千名愤怒的公民冲进了学校场地
hearken /'hɑːkən/ v.i. 倾听
The situation hearkened back to the dangerous federal-state conflicts of the 19th century that followed the end of the Civil War.
中文语境：这种情况让人回想起19世纪内战结束后危险的联邦与州冲突
mobilize /'məubilaiz/ v.t. 动员, 调动, 使流通；v.i. 动员

Under the pretext of maintaining order but in support of the segregationists, Arkansas Governor Orval Faubus mobilized the Arkansas National Guard to prevent the Little Rock Nine from entering the school.
中文语境：阿肯色州州长奥瓦尔·福布斯以维持秩序为借口，支持种族隔离主义者，动员阿肯色州国民警卫队阻止小石城九人进入学校
supervision /.sjuːpə'viʒən/ n. 监督, 管理；[经] 监督, 管理
For the next few months, the African American students attended school under armed supervision.
中文语境：接下来的几个月里，非裔美国学生在武装监督下上学
willpower /'wilpauə/ n. 毅力, 意志力
Still, the Confederacy was not without resources and willpower.
中文语境：尽管如此，南部邦联并非没有资源和意志力
resourceful /ri'sɒːsful/ adj. 资源丰富的, 策略的, 机智的；[法] 资源丰富的, 善于遂机应变的, 足智多谋的
The South also proved to be very resourceful.
中文语境：事实证明，南方也非常足智多谋
gunpowder /'gʌnpaudə/ n. 火药；[化] 有烟火药; 火药
All of the principal ingredients of gunpowder were imported.
中文语境：火药的所有主要成分都是进口的
nucleus /'njuːkliəs/ n. 核心, 核子, 原子核, 起点；[计] 核心程序
The South also had a great nucleus of trained officers.
中文语境：南方也有一支训练有素的军官队伍
blockade /blɒ'keid/ n. 阻塞；v.t. 封锁
A blockade could suffocate the South.
中文语境：封锁可能会让南方窒息
formidable /'fɒːmidəbl/ adj. 巨大的, 优秀的, 可怕的, 艰难的
It had to destroy the South's capacity and will to resist - a formidable challenge in any war.
中文语境：它必须摧毁南方的抵抗能力和意志--这在任何战争中都是一个巨大的挑战
touchstone /'tʌtʃstəun/ n. 试金石, 检验标准
Eventually, pyramids, mummies, and great cities became touchstones of this flourishing culture.
中文语境：最终，金字塔、木乃伊和大城市成为了这种繁荣文化的试金石
cohesive /kəu'hiːsiv/ adj. 黏合在一起的；[医] 内聚的
that the valley's inhabitants began to form a cohesive civilization.
中文语境：山谷里的居民开始形成有凝聚力的文明
fabricate /'fæbrikeit/ v.t. 制造, 建造, 装配, 伪造
Egyptian artisans created copper tools such as chisels and needles - all new inventions - that allowed them to fabricate ornamental jewelry.
中文语境：埃及工匠创造了凿子和针等铜工具--所有新发明--使他们能够制造装饰性珠宝
surplus /'səːpləs/ n. 剩余, 过剩, 盈余；adj. 过剩的, 剩余的
Farmers began producing surplus crops that allowed others to move their concentration from farming to pursuing other trades, such as mercantilism or skilled craftwork.
中文语境：农民开始生产剩余作物，使其他人能够将注意力从农业转移到其他行业，例如重商主义或熟练手工艺
auspice /'ɒːspis/ n. 吉兆, 占卜, 赞助
Refugees fall under the auspice of the U.N.
中文语境：难民受到联合国的支持
overshadow /.əuvə'ʃædəu/ v.t. 遮阴, 使阴暗, 使失色, 使相形见绌, 使蒙上阴影
In 2016 there were 40.3 million internally displaced persons around the world, far overshadowing the 25.3 million refugees.
